title: Uruguayan Choripán Skewers with Spicy Chimichurri
description: A classic Uruguayan street food, choripán is a grilled chorizo sandwich, typically served on a crusty bun and topped with chimichurri sauce. This recipe adds a spicy twist to the traditional recipe, perfect for a summer cookout.
instructions: Thread skirt steak, chorizo, onion, and bell pepper onto skewers.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Meanwhile, combine red wine vinegar, oregano, garlic, and red pepper flakes in a bowl.
Stir to combine and set aside.
Once skewers are cooked, brush with chimichurri sauce.
Serve hot on crusty buns with additional chimichurri sauce on the side.
Optional: grill buns for 2-3 minutes before serving.
